## Summary

Describe the problem and the proposed solution.

## Related issue

Closes #

## Change type

- [ ] Feature
- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] Refactor
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Build, CI, or tooling
- [ ] Security or privacy change

## Validation

- [ ] `dart format --set-exit-if-changed .`
- [ ] `flutter analyze`
- [ ] `flutter test --dart-define=TELEGRAM_API_ID=0 --dart-define=TELEGRAM_API_HASH=placeholder`
- [ ] Tested on Android where applicable
- [ ] Added or updated tests for behavior changes

## Risk review

- [ ] No credentials, signing material, Telegram sessions, user media, databases, logs, or backup files are included
- [ ] Privacy and security behavior is documented accurately
- [ ] Android permission changes are explained
- [ ] Telegram login, sync, bucket, vault, encryption, restore, or deletion impact is explained
- [ ] UI changes include screenshots or recordings

## Release impact

State whether this change requires migration work, release notes, Play Store review, or no release action.
